Method of Attack: Disc-encrypting ransomware encrypts the drive using Salsa20 algorithm
Attempts to gain administrative privileges to install disc encryptor
If fails, installs Mischa file encrypting ransomware instead
Pretends to be a PDF file
Distributed via malicious resume files named Bewerbungsmappe targeting HR departments
Impacted Systems: Companies especially German companies' HR departments
Attack Vector: Malicious installer disguised as PDF or resume files
Social engineering via fake job applicant resumes
